records.claim: One study reported that duloxetine was not associated with effects on men’s fertility (ability to make healthy sperm). Studies have not been done in men to see if duloxetine can increase the chance of birth defects. In general, exposures that fathers or sperm donors have are unlikely to increase risks to a pregnancy. For more information, please see the MotherToBaby fact sheet Paternal Exposures at https://mothertobaby.org/fact-sheets/paternal-exposures-pregnancy/.
records.source_section: If a man takes duloxetine, could it affect fertility or increase the chance of birth defects?
